description: Check Korean text for spelling and spacing errors with the free rule-based engine of The Korean Today (코리안투데이). Returns issues with positions, the suggested correction, level ("error" = certain, "check" = please review) and a short reason in Korean. Proper nouns, quotes and style are not changed. Up to 10000 characters per call.

apply.description: Also return corrected_text with all level="error" fixes applied

offset_unit.description: Unit of start/end offsets in the result (Python/most languages: codepoint; JavaScript: utf16)

name: check_korean
title: Korean spell checker (코리안투데이 맞춤법 검사기)
